exposure: Cesarean delivery (as a factor to examine its association with adverse outcomes)
cohort: The study included 1,618 women who delivered at a hospital in Ethiopia.
finding: Approximately 20% of mothers experienced adverse outcomes, which were significantly associated with nonuse of antenatal care (AOR 2.95), nonuse of prophylaxis (AOR 3.18), history of medical illness (AOR 4.28), and use of substandard operation setup (AOR 7.09).
